name: New Issue
overview: [excited] Let's report a new Issue! Think of this... as logging a problem — like missing linen or quality defects. [friendly] It dynamically changes depending on if the source is a Customer or a Laundry vendor. Let's walk through it!

nodes.label: Issue Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] When did this happen? Just pick the date.

nodes.label: Source Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] Who is this about? A CUSTOMER hotel or a LAUNDRY vendor? This choice changes what happens next!

explain.full: [curious] Who is this about? A CUSTOMER hotel or a LAUNDRY vendor? This choice changes the Source Name and Trigger Entity.

nodes.label: Source Name
nodes.explanation: [casual] Search and pick the exact Customer or Vendor.

explain.full: [casual] Search and pick the exact Customer or Vendor involved.

delta.CUSTOMER: [casual] Let's pick the customer hotel... Arama Suites.
delta.LAUNDRY: [casual] Let's pick the laundry vendor... LinenCare Services.

nodes.label: Trigger Entity
nodes.explanation: [casual] What triggered this? An ORDER or a WASH FULFILLMENT?

explain.full: [casual] What triggered this? An ORDER or a WASH FULFILLMENT?

delta.CUSTOMER: [curious] Notice it auto-changed to ORDER for the customer!
delta.LAUNDRY: [curious] Notice it auto-changed to WASH_FULFILLMENT for the laundry!

nodes.label: Order Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This loads their orders for that day.

explain.full: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This automatically loads their orders for that day.

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.emptyMessage: No orders found for this selection. You can still continue without linking one.
nodes.explanation: [casual] Link a specific order... if there is one.

nodes.label: Wash Date
nodes.explanation: [casual] Pick the Wash Date to link this to laundry processing.

explain.full: [casual] Pick the Wash Date to link this issue with laundry processing on that day.

nodes.label: Issue Type
nodes.explanation: [curious] What's the category? Missing items, quality defects... pick one.

nodes.label: Status
nodes.explanation: [casual] What's the initial status? Usually OPEN.

nodes.label: Description
nodes.explanation: [casual] Give us the details. What EXACTLY happened?

nodes.label: Product
nodes.explanation: [casual] Which product is affected? This is optional, but helpful.

nodes.label: Quantity
nodes.explanation: [casual] How many items were affected? Just the number.

wrapUp: [warm and satisfied] And that's all for reporting this issue! [friendly] We've logged all the details. Nothing was saved... but whenever you are ready, go report a REAL issue. You've got this!
description: Walkthrough for creating a new issue in the issue tracker
